summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16, attaching a Hong Kong Exchange announcement regarding a board meeting scheduled for May 27, 2026 to consider and approve first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing is a routine earnings announcement notice with no special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The board meeting and earnings release are standard corporate procedures.
